summary: Woman reported wandering in the Imogene Pass basin after an ATV accident; treated at the scene, packaged into a litter and carried to an awaiting ambulance at Camp Bird Mine.
notes: Team lieutenant responded 2:45 p.m. near the pass summit; ATV and additional personnel followed.
